highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia milestone m148 with variable-font and WebP support.
highlights_body: It rolls up all 4.147.x preview work: variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, a reworked singleton lifecycle, and the final promotion of v3-era obsolete APIs to compile errors. This is a breaking release — review the changes before upgrading from 3.x.

breaking.title: SKPaint text/font members are now compile errors
breaking.body: The text and font members on SKPaint that were marked Obsolete in v3 (Typeface, TextSize, etc.) are now errors. Move typeface and text-size settings to SKFont.

breaking.title: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost value-equality and was renamed
breaking.body: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo was retyped from GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. The old type lost IEquatable<T> and its == / != operators. Update any equality checks to use the new type.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed
breaking.body: The protected set accessor on IgnorePublicDispose was removed; it can only be set from the constructor. Custom SKNativeObject subclasses that assigned this property must switch to the constructor parameter.

breaking.title: new SKFont() typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty, not null
breaking.body: Upstream Skia m132 removed lazy default-typeface resolution. new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty (0 glyphs) instead of null. MeasureText returns 0 and nothing is drawn unless you supply an explicit typeface. Pass SKTypeface.Default (or any loaded typeface) to restore drawing behaviour.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface returns Default instead of null
breaking.body: new SKPaint().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Default (non-null). Code that checked paint.Typeface == null to detect an unset typeface no longer fires; use paint.Typeface.IsEmpty, or drop the check since a usable default is always present.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName for an unknown family returns Default on Android
breaking.body: On Android, looking up an unknown font family now returns SKTypeface.Default instead of null. Null checks on the return value must be replaced with IsEmpty checks.

breaking.title: Vulkan 1.0 instances are no longer tolerated — the process aborts
breaking.body: Skia now calls SK_ABORT (process termination, not a catchable exception) when a Vulkan 1.0 instance or device is used. Set VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to at least VK_API_VERSION_1_1.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative: five fields removed
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed from GRVkBackendContextNative. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions, fDeviceFeatures / fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures, and delete the rest.

breaking.title: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo layout changed — new Components field added
breaking.body: A new Components field (GRVkYcbcrComponents struct) was added to GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo, changing its binary layout. Code that manually constructs or marshals the struct must add the new field.

breaking.title: Singleton lifecycle reworked — SKObject handles may be recreated
breaking.body: The internal singleton-instance tracking was rewritten. Objects that were previously cached forever may now be recreated; code that compared SKObject instances by reference identity (rather than by handle) may see new instances. This also fixes finalization-order crashes.

bullets.lead: Skia engine upgraded from m132 through m148
bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine advanced through milestones m132, m133, and m147, landing at the m148 stable release, bringing years of upstream rendering improvements and bug fixes.
Two rounds of upstream chrome/m147 bug fixes were merged, pulling in Ganesh correctness and stability improvements.

bullets.lead: Variable font support added to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp
bullets.detail: Variable fonts (OpenType font variations) are now fully supported. SKFont and SKTypeface expose variation axes and named instances, and HarfBuzzSharp gains matching shaping support. Color font palettes are also exposed.
SKWebpEncoder now supports encoding animated WebP sequences, giving .NET apps a first-class animated image output format.
A new SKStream.GetData() method returns the underlying data buffer without copying when the stream supports it, reducing allocations in codec and serialization paths.
Both drawing methods gained a SKSamplingOptions overload, giving callers explicit control over filtering quality when compositing surfaces.

bullets.lead: HBColor value type and missing HarfBuzz API wrappers added
bullets.detail: HBColor is a new struct giving proper .NET representation to hb_color_t. Gaps in the HarfBuzz binding surface were filled and naming-convention violations were corrected.

bullets.lead: SKPixmap and SKBitmap pixel-span offset and stride fixed
bullets.detail: GetPixelSpan<T>(x,y) was using Height instead of Width for the X offset, and stride was computed from Width×BytesPerPixel instead of RowBytes, causing incorrect pixel reads on padded bitmaps.

bullets.lead: Default-typeface resolution moved to the managed layer
bullets.detail: The platform default typeface is now resolved in managed code before reaching native, making behaviour consistent across platforms and fixing cases where no text was drawn.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first fixed
bullets.detail: A finalizer-ordering crash occurred when an SKPath outlived the SKPathBuilder that produced it. The path now holds its own reference to the builder.
WinUI consumers on .NET 9 no longer hit a missing Projection DLL at runtime.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView rendering restored after MAUI TabBar tab switch
bullets.detail: SKGLView on Android stopped rendering when the containing MAUI TabBar tab was deactivated and reactivated; the surface is now correctly re-established.
The lifetime tracking of singleton SKObject instances (e.g. SKTypeface.Default) was redesigned to prevent finalizer-order crashes and ensure handles are not reused after disposal.

bullets.lead: Native-compat gate moved from ModuleInitializer to SkiaApi static constructor
bullets.detail: The check that ensures the native library version matches the managed bindings now runs in the SkiaApi static constructor instead of a module initializer, fixing startup ordering issues in some host environments.

bullets.lead: Linux Bionic (Android NDK toolchain) native assets added
bullets.detail: Linux Bionic targets used by the Android NDK toolchain are now included in the native asset package.

bullets.lead: Tizen x64 and arm64 native build support
bullets.detail: The Tizen native build now produces x64 and arm64 binaries in addition to the existing arm32 target.

bullets.lead: Apple platform TFMs aligned: 26.0 for libraries, unversioned for apps
bullets.detail: Apple library TFMs now use the versioned 26.0 form and app TFMs use the unversioned form, fixing asset resolution for .NET 9+ Apple consumers.

bullets.lead: WASM: dropped pre-.NET 8 Emscripten native builds
bullets.detail: Native WASM builds for Emscripten versions targeting pre-.NET 8 runtimes have been removed, reducing package size.
libpng was updated to 1.6.58, libexpat to 2.7.5 and 2.8.1, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, freetype to 2.14.3, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, and HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Skia milestone bumps (m132, m147), variable font support, singleton lifecycle rework, SKPaint/SKFont v4 API promotion, SKPath finalizer fix, and Uno Gallery sample maintenance.
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets support and PolySharp C# 13 compatibility for legacy TFMs.
contributor_summaries.ebariche: Community contributions across samples and tooling.
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after a MAUI TabBar tab switch on Android.

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line with the Skia m132/m133/m147 engine upgrade, variable font support, color palette support, and new platform targets (Linux Bionic, Tizen arm64/x64).
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData(), Apple TFM alignment, and the SKPath finalizer crash fix.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added HBColor, missing HarfBuzz API wrappers, native-dependency refreshes (freetype, zlib, libjpeg-turbo), and dropped pre-.NET 8 WASM builds.
preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: RC 1 landed Skia m148, the singleton lifecycle rework, SKPaint text API promotions to error, SKPixmap pixel-span fixes, and the WinUI .NET 9 fix.

harfbuzz_summary: Adds variable-font shaping, color-font palette support, the new HBColor value type for hb_color_t, and refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz engine to 14.2.0.
